description: This file defines a Fragment in an Android application responsible for displaying and managing a list of tasks in a TV interface. It includes UI handling, filtering, interactions with a ViewModel, and communication callbacks.

classes.name: TaskListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a grid of tasks with filtering options for a TV interface. It manages UI interactions, task filtering, and communicates with ViewModel and parent context.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to the context and sets up a listener if the context implements the designated interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel for tasks using a factory provided by ServiceLocator.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout using view binding and returns the root view.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters the task list based on the selected filter state and updates the adapter; manages focus based on list emptiness.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView, filter buttons, and UI interactions, observes task data, and manages initial focus.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up bindings when the view is destroyed to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TaskListFragment.
